lines.zh: 我摆尾穿过水草，一点声都没有。
lines.en: I flick through the weeds without a sound.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被我搅起一层。
lines.en: I stir a layer of mud off the bottom.
I swim along the bank, hunting shade.

lines.zh: 前面有根沉木，我从底下钻过。
lines.en: A sunken log ahead; I slip beneath it.

lines.zh: 水流带路，我跟着它往前。
lines.en: The current leads; I follow it downstream.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一扇，转了个小弯。
lines.en: One flick of a fin and I turn.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我眼花。
lines.en: The light on the surface dazzles me.
I swim slowly, as if waiting.

lines.zh: 一群同伴从我旁边掠过。
lines.en: A school of my kin streaks past.
The current pushes me; my teeth arrive first.

lines.zh: 水凉，我的动作也慢下来。
lines.en: The water's cold; my movements slow.

lines.zh: 我绕开那丛带刺的水草。
lines.en: I steer around that thorny patch of weed.

lines.zh: 河底的沙子很细，蹭着肚子。
lines.en: Fine sand on the riverbed brushes my belly.
I sink deeper, where the water darkens.

lines.zh: 我成群转了个弯，水都跟着旋。
lines.en: The school turns and the water swirls with us.

lines.zh: 我逆着水流顶了几格，鱼鳞发亮。
lines.en: I push a few blocks upstream, scales glinting.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，水从齿缝里穿过去。
lines.en: Mouth open, I let water thread between my teeth.

lines.zh: 一串串泡泡从我鳃边浮上去。
lines.en: Bubbles drift off my gills in little chains.

lines.zh: 我停在水草中间，几乎不动。
lines.en: I hang among the weeds, almost still.

lines.zh: 有片叶子沉下来，我看了一会儿。
lines.en: A leaf sinks past; I watch it a while.
My scales shine even in the dark.
Those little fish stay well away.
I sweep my tail across the riverbed.
A ripple on the surface — rain.
I turn side-on and let water rush my gills.
Only dripping in this cave pool.

lines.zh: 我数不清同伴有多少条。
lines.en: I can't count how many of us there are.
Another tooth has grown in.

lines.zh: 光从洞口照下来，一条斜线。
lines.en: Light slants down from the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏进那团黑里。
lines.en: I fold myself into that patch of black.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面那条抖动的线。
lines.en: I stare at the shivering line on the surface.

lines.zh: 我把下颌张到最大，又合上。
lines.en: I open my jaw wide, then close it.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水面，慢慢晃。
lines.en: Your shadow settles on the water and sways.

lines.zh: 你把手指伸进来，我看见了。
lines.en: You dip a finger in; I saw it.

lines.zh: 你在岸上蹲下，我浮到水边。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; I rise to the edge.

lines.zh: 你的靴子湿了，水到我这儿。
lines.en: Your boots are wet; the water reaches me.
I won't bite you, unless you come in.

lines.zh: 你把脸贴近，我往后退了退。
lines.en: You bring your face close; I back away.
There's fish smell on your hands.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，水在中间流。
lines.en: We watch each other, water flowing between.

lines.zh: 你扔下一片面包，我不会吃。
lines.en: You toss in bread; I won't eat it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你垂下的手转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the hand you let hang down.
Your reflection is far bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我浮上来一点，看清你的脸。
lines.en: I rise a little to see your face.
One tail-flick and I'm into the rocks.
A scale is scraped off my flank.
The water clouds; I can't see.
Who bumped me among the weeds?
I roll over and swim crooked.
That blow spun my sense of direction.
I hide among the school.
My mouth is full of mud.
I sink deeper, where it's darker.
Stop chasing; I swim faster than you.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼还在动，快给我。
lines.en: That little fish still wriggles — give it here.

lines.zh: 生鳕鱼的味道，我隔着水也闻到。
lines.en: Raw cod — I smell it through the water.

lines.zh: 你把它丢在水面，我自己来。
lines.en: Drop it on the surface; I'll come.
Not the net; I'd get tangled.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块肉游了两圈。
lines.en: I circle that piece of meat twice.

lines.zh: 你的诱饵太小了，不够分。
lines.en: Your bait is too small to share.

lines.zh: 水一动，我的牙就露出来。
lines.en: The water stirs and my teeth show.
A little closer — don't pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 那桶水里有同伴的味道。
lines.en: That bucket smells of my kin.
I bit it — it's a lure.

lines.zh: 你把鱼挂在钩上，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the fish on your hook.
I eat what moves, not what's dead.
Blood spreads in the water, warm.
Let me have one bite — just one.
The meat in your hand is dripping blood.

lines.zh: 你把桶放低，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: Lower the bucket and I dare come closer.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的小腿上，滑开了。
lines.en: I bump your calf and slide off.
Sorry — I can't see well in here.

lines.zh: 你踩到底了，泥全起来了。
lines.en: You touched bottom; mud clouds everything.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子碰到石头，有点麻。
lines.en: My snout hit stone; it's numb.

lines.zh: 一群鱼同时转身，撞成一团。
lines.en: The school turns at once and collides.

lines.zh: 你的桶壁好硬，我撞不破。
lines.en: The bucket wall is hard; I can't break it.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边擦过去，鳞都竖了。
lines.en: I graze your leg, scales bristling.
Don't flick at me; I'll bite.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，我分不清方向。
lines.en: The water's murky now; I've lost direction.
I back off and let you pass.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳍几乎相碰。
lines.en: We swim abreast, fins almost touching.
Yours is a deeper red than mine.
Half that fish is yours.

lines.zh: 我们一起绕那块石头转。
lines.en: Let's circle that stone together.
In the weeds, we keep very close.

lines.zh: 你咬我尾巴，是打招呼吗？
lines.en: Biting my tail — is that your greeting?

lines.zh: 等小的孵出来，会有一大群。
lines.en: When the small ones hatch, we'll be a crowd.
Don't swim so fast; I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我们在同一道水缝里躲着。
lines.en: We hide in the same water gap.
Under this stone again tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，它就没动了。
lines.en: One bite and it stops moving.
This fish is small; I'll carry it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶了顶，它沉下去了。
lines.en: I nudge it and it sinks.
I tuck it under a stone.
Whatever falls in is ours.
Carrying something makes me swim crooked.
This won't give — it's bone.
I swallowed it, and it's still moving.
I snatch a bite and dart away.
My mouth is too full to close.
The surface moved, and not from wind.

lines.zh: 有条鱼自己游进了我的地盘。
lines.en: A fish has wandered into my water.
I've caught the smell of blood.
Something moves inside the rock crack.
The weeds shake, and not from current.
My kin have turned this way too.
A shadow drops from above.
Those bubbles weren't made by a fish.
My back fin rises; I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 就是那条，落在最后面的。
lines.en: That one — the straggler at the back.
I trail along the bed without stirring mud.
It heads for shallows, where it's slow.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切过去，截住它。
lines.en: I cut in from the side and block it.
The others are closing in too.

lines.zh: 它钻进石缝，我等在外面。
lines.en: It darts into a crack; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，回到它背后。
lines.en: I loop around and come up behind it.
Too murky; I go by feel alone.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴在摆，越来越慢。
lines.en: Its tail beats slower and slower.
It's one bite away now.
I hold still and wait for it to tire.
My teeth sink in and stay.

lines.zh: 我先咬尾巴，让它游不快。
lines.en: I go for the tail first to slow it.

lines.zh: 一群一起上，水都翻白了。
lines.en: We all strike at once; the water churns white.
Its scales scrape my mouth raw.
I bite empty water; my teeth clash.
The blood smell drives the school wild.
I tear off a morsel and retreat.
It's bigger than us; we don't back off.
The surface bursts, and we keep biting.

lines.zh: 咬完我甩甩嘴，沉进暗处。
lines.en: Finished, I shake my snout and sink into the dark.

lines.zh: 我在浑水里睁眼，周围都是同伴。
lines.en: I open my eyes in murky water, kin all around.
The river is wide and green.
Roots hang from the bank above.

lines.zh: 我第一次摆尾，泥就散了。
lines.en: My first tailbeat stirs the mud.
The water is warm, tasting of jungle.
This rock crack is room enough to hide.

lines.zh: 有一条小鱼从我面前逃开。
lines.en: A small fish darts away from my face.
I try a bite of the water.
The light down here is green.

lines.zh: 我先绕着自己的地盘游一圈。
lines.en: First I make one lap of my territory.
The water scalds; I burrow into the mud.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在石头上。
lines.en: Flung from the water, I slap onto stone.
Out of water, my gills open and close.

lines.zh: 水里一声闷响，我被推出去。
lines.en: A muffled blast shoves me through the water.

lines.zh: 一支箭破开水面，钉在我身上。
lines.en: An arrow splits the surface and pins me.

lines.zh: 紫雾在水里散开，我发麻。
lines.en: Violet mist spreads underwater and numbs me.

lines.zh: 水里没有鱼，我饿得乱转。
lines.en: No fish in this water; I circle hungrily.
Lightning strikes the river and the water lights up.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我在空里扑腾。
lines.en: The water's gone; I thrash in nothing.
